summary: Preserve Node error-first callback, asynchronous completion, flags, and partial-write-on-abort semantics for fs.writeFile.

semantics.abort_signal: best effort; callback receives AbortError if cancellation wins
semantics.ordering: completion order with other async fs calls is not guaranteed

caveats: Callback exceptions must flow through the JS runtime/event-loop semantics, not be wrapped as .NET task exceptions.
Multiple overlapping writeFile calls to the same file can race/corrupt; do not serialize unless source does.

tests.name: callback after write
tests.expected_behavior: callback runs asynchronously after successful completion and reads x

tests.name: exclusive flag callback error
tests.expected_behavior: when a exists, callback receives a Node-compatible EEXIST-style error rather than a synchronous success
